-- =================================================================
-- Description:	Obtiene los tickets de un usuario en particular
-- =================================================================
CREATE PROCEDURE [dbo].[rpt_Ticket_ObtenerPorSuscriptor]
@EntityId AS INT = 0, 
@Comunidad_Id AS INT = 0, 
@Suscriptor_Id AS INT = 0, 
@EstatusTicket_Id AS INT = 0, 
@CategoriaTicket_Id AS INT = 0
AS
BEGIN
	
	DECLARE @MembresiasSeleccionadas TABLE (
		Id INT IDENTITY (1,1),
		Membresia_Id INT		
	)

	--OBTENER LAS MEMBRESIAS DEL SUSCRIPTOR
	INSERT INTO @MembresiasSeleccionadas (Membresia_Id)
	SELECT 
		mem.Id 
	FROM dbo.Suscripcion sus 
		LEFT JOIN Membresia mem 
			ON sus.Membresia_Id = mem.Id
	WHERE 
		sus.Suscriptor_Id = @Suscriptor_Id 
	AND sus.Activo = 1
	AND mem.Activo = 1
	AND mem.EstatusMembresia_Id = 1 --solo membresias activas

	-- IMPORTANT:
	-- This is a computer generated procedure.  DO NOT ADD CUSTOM CODE TO THIS PROCEDURE.

	-- SET NOCOUNT ON added to prevent extra result sets from
	-- interfering with SELECT statements.
	SET NOCOUNT ON;
	
	-- 1) CREATE FILTER TABLE:
	DECLARE @TicketFilter TABLE (
		Id INT IDENTITY (1,1),
		Ticket_Id INT		
	)


    -- IF A GIVEN ID HAS BEEN SPECIFIED, THEN RETRIEVE THAT RECORD ONLY
	IF @EntityId <> 0
	BEGIN

		INSERT INTO @TicketFilter (Ticket_Id)
		SELECT 
			[Ticket].Id
		FROM [dbo].[Ticket]
		WHERE
			 [dbo].[Ticket].[Id] = @EntityId

	END
	ELSE
	BEGIN

		-- 2) FILTER BY FOREIGN RELATIONSHIPS WHEN APLICABLE:
		INSERT INTO @TicketFilter (Ticket_Id)
		SELECT 
			[Ticket].Id
		FROM [dbo].[Ticket]
		WHERE
			 [Ticket].[Activo] = 1 AND
         (([Ticket].[Comunidad_Id] = @Comunidad_Id) OR (@Comunidad_Id = 0)) AND         
         (([Ticket].[EstatusTicket_Id] = @EstatusTicket_Id) OR (@EstatusTicket_Id = 0)) AND
         (([Ticket].[CategoriaTicket_Id] = @CategoriaTicket_Id) OR (@CategoriaTicket_Id = 0))

 	END
 
	-- 4) DELIVER THE FILTERED RESULTS:
	SELECT 
		[Ticket].[Id],		
		[Ticket].[Titulo],
		[Ticket].[Descripcion],		
		[Ticket].[Activo],
		[Ticket].[FechaDesactivacion],
		[Ticket].[DesactivadoPor],
		[Comunidad].[Nombre] AS [Comunidad],
		[Membresia].[ClaveMembresia] AS [ClaveMembresia],		
		[Suscriptor].[Nombre] + ' ' + [Suscriptor].[ApellidoPaterno] +  ' ' +  [Suscriptor].[ApellidoMaterno] AS [Suscriptor],
		[Suscriptor].[CorreoElectronico] AS [CorreoElectronico],
		[EstatusTicket].[Nombre] AS [Estatus],
		[CategoriaTicket].[Nombre] AS [Categoria],
		[Ticket].[FechaCreacion],
		[Ticket].[CreadoPor],
		[Ticket].[FechaModificacion],
		[Ticket].[ModificadoPor]
	FROM @TicketFilter filter
		JOIN [dbo].[Ticket] 
			ON [Ticket].[Id] = filter.[Ticket_Id] 

		JOIN @MembresiasSeleccionadas mem1
			ON [Ticket].[Membresia_Id] = mem1.Membresia_Id			

		LEFT JOIN [dbo].[Comunidad]
		ON [dbo].[Ticket].[Comunidad_Id] = [dbo].[Comunidad].[Id] 

 		LEFT JOIN [dbo].[Suscriptor]
		ON [dbo].[Ticket].[Suscriptor_Id] = [dbo].[Suscriptor].[Id] 

 		LEFT JOIN [dbo].[EstatusTicket]
		ON [dbo].[Ticket].[EstatusTicket_Id] = [dbo].[EstatusTicket].[Id] 

 		LEFT JOIN [dbo].[CategoriaTicket]
		ON [dbo].[Ticket].[CategoriaTicket_Id] = [dbo].[CategoriaTicket].[Id] 

		LEFT JOIN [dbo].[Membresia]
		ON [dbo].[Ticket].[Membresia_Id] = [dbo].[Membresia].[Id] 
 
END
-- END OF [dbo].[rpt_Ticket_ObtenerPorSuscriptor]
Name: rpt_Ticket_ObtenerPorSuscriptor
